name: Sub-Inspector in Delhi Police and Central Armed Police Forces Examination
department: Delhi Police; CRPF, BSF, ITBP, CISF, SSB (Ministry of Home Affairs)
summary: Graduate entry as Sub-Inspector in Delhi Police and the CAPFs, and SI (Fire) in CISF. Two computer-based papers, physical standards and endurance tests, and a medical. Level 6 pay.

status.note: Held every year. 2026 cycle: applications 10 to 30 September 2026; computer-based exam date to be announced.

posts.name: Sub-Inspector (Executive), Delhi Police
posts.responsibilities: Police station investigation and law and order in Delhi.

posts.name: Sub-Inspector (GD), CAPFs
posts.responsibilities: Platoon leader in CRPF, BSF, ITBP, CISF or SSB.

relaxations.note: After deducting military service from actual age, as per notice.

age.summary: Usually 20 to 25 years on 1 August of the exam year (check the current notice).

education.summary: A bachelor's degree from a recognised university. Delhi Police SI (men) also needs a valid driving licence (LMV) by the PET date, as per previous notices.

eligibility.physical: Physical Standards Test (height, chest, weight) and Physical Endurance Test (race, long jump, high jump, shot put) as listed in the notice; standards differ for men and women and for some regional groups.
eligibility.examVsPost: Delhi Police SI and CAPF SI are filled from one exam but have separate vacancies and some different conditions.
eligibility.reservation: Central reservation: SC 15%, ST 7.5%, OBC (non-creamy layer) 27%, EWS 10%, plus horizontal reservation for PwBD and ex-servicemen as per rules.

eligibilityRules.notes: Under 25 on the reference date is the usual rule. Physical tests apply. Delhi Police SI men need a driving licence.

stages.name: Paper I (computer-based)
stages.notes: Revised 2026 pattern as reported: 100 marks, 1 hour, 15-minute timer per section.

stages.name: Paper II (computer-based)
stages.notes: Revised 2026 pattern as reported: four sections for 320 marks, with English Comprehension weighted most (200 marks). Confirm the exact pattern in the official notice.

selection.meritCalculation: Merit from Paper I and Paper II for candidates who qualify the physical tests and medical.
selection.languages: English and Hindi (English sections in English).
selection.probation: Training at the force or Delhi Police academy.

statistics.note: Tentative vacancies as reported (another report gives 2,018).

specialAllowances.name: Force allowances
specialAllowances.detail: Risk, hardship and ration allowances as per force rules.

career.promotionNotes: Promotion depends on the force and vacancies; CAPF SIs can also take the LDCE for Assistant Commandant.

benefits.detail: CGHS where available, LTC, earned and half-pay leave, HRA or government quarters, NPS with the UPS option.

workLife.postings: Delhi (Delhi Police) or anywhere in India including borders (CAPFs).

difficulty.rationale: Graduate-level written papers plus demanding physical tests for about 2,000 posts.

factors.note: The paper structure was revised in 2026.
